description: codex/ChatGPT second opinions should use the MAXIMUM reasoning effort the chosen model supports. The setup-chatgpt MCP template defaulted effort to 'high'; bump to 'max'. Valid API efforts ascending: none < minimal < low < medium < high < xhigh < max. IMPORTANT: the ceiling is model-specific — gpt-5.4 REJECTS 'max' (invalid_request_error; its top is xhigh), while gpt-5.6-sol accepts 'max'. So the template's default model and effort must be coherent: default to a max-capable model (gpt-5.6-sol) when defaulting effort to 'max'. 'ultra' is NOT a real level (alpha CLIs echo it but the API enum rejects it, listing 'max' as top). gpt-5.6-sol's UNSET default effort is 'none' (under-powered) so effort must be passed explicitly. The ChatGPT.app bundled codex (/Applications/ChatGPT.app/Contents/Resources/codex) supports the newest models and is what the MCP wraps; the PATH codex may be too old.
